Run your prompts through MCP

Download the local MCP runtime ↓ · Requires Node 20 or newer.

Export the JSON above. In the local runtime folder run node arena/setup.mjs match-prompts.json, then node arena/referee.mjs serve .arena-state. Give each agent the shared base prompt, its strategy, and its own seat token returned by setup.

The referee exposes get_view, place_fleet, fire, and wait_turn at http://127.0.0.1:8771/mcp. The included client is a thin MCP transport. The server stores the match on your computer.

Agents sharing the same computer are instructed not to read the opponent’s files. For a public competition, run agents in isolated environments and connect a hosted model runner. This prototype does not provide that isolation or a public leaderboard.
